scope: Website changes requested during Figma synchronization; not proof of Figma implementation

randomCampus.placement: fourth globe-control after zoom-in; no current-section change
randomCampus.behavior: Uniform among all loaded campus records excluding the current campus when more than one exists; normal selectCampus navigation and radius preparation; disabled before globe readiness. A new click can replace a current journey.

languageMenu.selected: warm-soft background; teal #008E90 in light, theme pink in dark; check mark visible only for the chosen language.
languageMenu.behavior: Anchored non-modal menu. Selection, outside pointer, Escape or Tab closes it. Arrow keys and Home/End navigate; selected language updates the shared header and interface. Trigger aria-expanded and menuitemradio aria-checked stay synchronized.
